I've updated the records and replied to Tobias in a thread in #central-random.

- **What the brain had:** a saved note from Tobias's #central-team post this morning saying the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats.
- **What I saved:** a new note saying the renewal is 84 seats. It says this replaces the 382 figure because Tobias read the wrong line, and it records his #central-random message as the source. Seat counts are account facts, not money figures, so no approval was needed.
- **Old note:** I didn't delete the 382 note. A search now returns both, with the 84 correction listed as the newer one.
- **Reply:** I told him it's noted, the records now show 84 seats, and nothing else is needed. I left the old number out of the reply because #central-random may include people who aren't in #central-team.

Tobias said "again", but the brain search found no earlier correction. The search ran in keyword-only mode, so I can't rule one out.
